input.body:
Brooke,

Before I put my name on closing out the Preventive Maintenance Push, I went back through Linear, the Airtable ticket log, and the #maintenance thread and reconciled them against what's actually in the field. Bottom line up front: this should NOT be treated as closeable yet, and my earlier QC sign-off on South/North does not hold. Reasons and the cluster-by-cluster picture below.

On my QC, plainly:
- My portfolio-wide FILTER spot-check (OPS-96, 5/30) is a PASS and stands.
- My South/North HVAC sign-off (OPS-98 / OPS-87, 5/25) does NOT hold, and I've withdrawn it. It was a sample spot-check, and it did not cover two things I already knew about: (1) on 5/23 I flagged two North units needing HVAC attention right away — coil, plumbing and panel notes — and there's no record they were ever corrected; (2) a South unit was missed on access (tenant not home) with no record it was ever serviced. I can't certify clusters as clean when units I flagged were never closed out.
- I never QC'd East or West at all — so any record showing those as "QC passed" is wrong (I've corrected OPS-99/OPS-108).

Cluster by cluster — what's open, who holds it, what has to happen before close:

NORTH (HVAC) — OPEN. Two units I flagged 5/23 (immediate HVAC: coil/plumbing/panel) were never worked as orders. Logged as Airtable MT-2026-PMF-01. Holder: John Smith / Elias Navarro (service). Close condition: both units re-serviced and confirmed, then I re-inspect.

SOUTH (HVAC) — OPEN. One unit missed on access, no record of service. Logged as MT-2026-PMF-02. Holder: Carlos Mendez (re-notice access) + Elias Navarro (service). Close condition: unit serviced, then I re-inspect.

EAST (HVAC) — OPEN (QC). Service is complete (Elias, OPS-108 in review for me) but it was never QC'd. Tracked as OPS-1000. Holder: me (Jaime). Close condition: I run the East spot-check and it passes.

WEST (HVAC) — OPEN (QC). Service complete by Lisa (OPS-91) but no QC on file. Tracked as OPS-1001. Holder: me (Jaime). Close condition: I run the West spot-check and it passes.

HVAC WATCH (portfolio) — OPEN. Elias's 5/20 flags: two recurring condensate-drain clogs + one compressor to watch. Logged as MT-2026-PMF-03. Holder: Elias Navarro. Close condition: drains re-cleared, compressor assessed.

PLUMBING — OPEN. From Carlos's inspection (OPS-97): two water heaters need replacement (not repair) — tracked as OPS-1002, holder: you (vendor quotes + owner approval). Hose-bib repairs — MT-2026-PMF-04, holder: Carlos Mendez. Close condition: water heaters replaced and hose bibs repaired.

ELECTRICAL — OPEN. Only Patricia's cluster panel inspections are confirmed complete; West is still underway and the rest isn't confirmed (OPS-186, holder: you). Close condition: remaining clusters inspected and findings documented.

Next step on my side: I'm back onsite 7/7 to re-inspect the four PMF tickets and run the East and West QC. Once the techs close their items and my re-inspection passes, I'll certify and we can close the push. Until then it stays open.

Happy to walk any of this at the next ops sync.

Thanks,
Jaime
